title: Antarctic ‘Skull’ Island Loses Its Snow Cover
paragraphs: A NASA satellite took photos of Vega Island. It is a small island in Antarctica. From above, the ice looks like a skull.
The first photo is from March 2025. Snow covers the ice. The second photo is from October 2026. In many places, the snow is gone. You can see dark ice.
The winter of 2026 was warm. Not much new snow fell. Dark ice takes more sun than snow, so it can melt faster.

questions.q: What does Vega Island look like from above?
What is gone in many places in October 2026?
Why can dark ice melt faster?
questions.a: It takes more sun than snow.
